definitions.big: at least 100 body anchors at the measured anchor (not lifetime reports)
definitions.speed: 9 * 42 / span of 9 neighboring intervals; skip >15% reported speed spread
definitions.delay: receipt minus server time, minus inclusive rolling minimum over +/-600 post-setup frames
definitions.cadence: setup-to-last-frame duration; setup excluded from frame count and delay; gaps start at setup
definitions.families: census command/length counts including setup, divided by setup-to-last duration
definitions.pooling: pool raw samples within epochs/captures; never average quantiles
definitions.limits: correlated samples; receipt includes network/collector stalls; no stock-renderer simulation
